name: wecom-mcp
description: WeCom (企业微信) (messaging): me, send. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_wecom_corpid.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WECOM_CORPID
platform_mcp_wecom_corpid.description: Enterprise ID (我的企业 > 企业信息), sent with corpsecret to GET https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/gettoken; the returned access_token (7200 s) travels as the access_token query parameter of every call.

platform_mcp_wecom_corpsecret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WECOM_CORPSECRET
platform_mcp_wecom_corpsecret.description: Secret of the self-built app (应用管理 > 应用 > Secret); each app has its own secret and token. Do not call gettoken frequently (rate-limited); the runtime caches the token.

platform_mcp_wecom_agent_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WECOM_AGENT_ID
platform_mcp_wecom_agent_id.description: AgentId (integer) of the self-built app shown on its settings page; required by message/send and agent/get.

tools.name: me
tools.description: agent/get: the app's name, description, allow_userinfos, visibility; verifies corpid/corpsecret and agent_id together.

tools.name: send
tools.description: App text message: `to` is one or more member UserIDs joined with '|' (max 1,000) or @all; content up to 2,048 bytes. Per app ≤ 30 messages/minute and 1,000/hour to the same member. Recipients that could not be reached come back in raw.invaliduser / unlicenseduser with errcode 0; message_id is msgid (for recall). `subject`/`channel` are ignored.
